statement: The maintainer reported that Eden saw Xbox virtual North/Y as X and did not pick up West/X before a documented standard HID button-usage correction.

applicability.revision: virtualgamepad alpha-1 historical observation, pinned document c60c1640
applicability.scope: User-reported, unversioned Eden observation. Standard-HID mapping, not XInput or physical controller; do not treat reported mismap as reproduced post-correction.
